title: MASTER — Full Pilot Story
text: All 24 scenes and 222 dialogue lines in story order, in one 20-minute file. This dialogue master preserves the original performances; pauses reserve space for action. Music and sound effects are not mixed into this version.

title: Scene 01 — play the dialogue assembly
text: Dialogue-only assembly; effects and final picture timing still needed.

title: S01-D01-byte-take001
text: Left! LEFT! That is a wall, Trixie!

title: S01-D02-trixie-take001
text: Relax. I found a shortcut.

title: S01-D03-byte-take001
text: Through the bank we just robbed?

title: S01-D04-neon-take001
text: My controller has input lag. I pressed jump yesterday.

title: S01-D05-onyx-take001
text: You are in a car. Why are you pressing jump?

title: S01-D06-neon-take001
text: Because she keeps driving into buildings!

title: S01-D07-trixie-take001
text: Nobody appreciates experimental driving.

title: S01-D08-byte-take001
text: The police appreciate it. All six helicopters.

title: S01-D09-onyx-take001
text: One more crash and somebody is going through that window.

title: S01-D10-neon-take001
text: In the game?

title: S01-D11-onyx-take001
text: Keep testing me.

title: S01-D12-ghost-take001
text: I finished the mission.

title: S01-D13-trixie-take001
text: How? We are still inside the bank.

title: S01-D14-ghost-take001
text: I walked out the back. With the money.

title: S01-D15-byte-take001
text: You left us?

title: S01-D16-ghost-take001
text: You said cover the exit. I covered my exit.

title: S01-D17-trixie-take001
text: Rematch. Nobody leaves the couch until we win.

title: Scene 02 — complete dialogue review
text: All dialogue in script order. Dialogue-only review; action, effects and final picture timing remain separate.

title: S02-N01-neon-take001
text: The console is still running. Look, my controller is connected. Something is taking over the television.

title: S02-N02-byte-take001
text: Great. Even our screen has a landlord.

title: S02-N03-trixie-take001
text: Try another channel. We paid for the game, not a lecture.

title: S02-N04-ghost-take001
text: Same signal on every channel. This is a district-wide override.

title: S02-N05-onyx-take001
text: They can fix every television at once, but not the lift in our building.

title: S02-N06-ghost-take001
text: That is not a fault. Somebody wants our attention.

title: Scene 03 — complete dialogue review
text: All dialogue in script order. Dialogue-only review; action, effects and final picture timing remain separate.

title: S03-D01-barkington-Matthew-current
text: Citizens of Districts Seven through Twelve. Due to an unprecedented salmon supply emergency, you are advised to acquire no less than thirty days of fresh salmon immediately. Goodboy Global thanks you for your obedience.

title: S03-N01-neon-take001
text: Seven through Twelve. Why are the first six districts missing from that map?

title: S03-N02-ghost-take001
text: Save the broadcast. The original file, with the time on it.

title: S03-N03-trixie-take001
text: We check the shop before we believe any of this.

title: S03-N04-byte-take001
text: With what money? The emergency does not come with an emergency wallet.

title: S03-N05-trixie-take001
text: Bring your scanner. We need prices, not another argument.

title: S03-N06-onyx-take001
text: I will keep the others here. Tell us what you find.

title: Scene 04 — complete dialogue review
text: All dialogue in script order. Dialogue-only review; action, effects and final picture timing remain separate.

title: S04-N01-byte-take001
text: That queue was not here ten minutes ago. They have not even opened the second till.

title: S04-N02-trixie-take001
text: Look at them. Everyone heard the same warning and ran for the same shelf.

title: S04-N03-civilian_2-take001
text: Please. That is the last tin. My little one has not eaten.

title: S04-N04-trixie-take001
text: Hey. There is room for both of you. Fighting each other will not fill the freezer.

title: S04-N05-byte-take001
text: The board says fresh delivery this morning. Why are they already rationing it?

title: S04-N06-trixie-take001
text: Photograph that notice. Let us see what changed inside.

title: Scene 05 — play the dialogue assembly
text: Dialogue-only assembly; effects and final picture timing still needed.

title: S05-D01-byte-take001
text: Thirty bucks for a piece of fish? Last week it was ten!

title: S05-D02-trixie-take001
text: Check the price history. When did it change?

title: S05-D03-byte-take001
text: Before the broadcast. They raised it before anyone knew there was an emergency.

title: S05-D04-trixie-take001
text: They knew. We were the last ones told.

title: S05-D05-byte-take001
text: Two packs left. At this price, we can afford to look at one.

title: S05-D06-trixie-take001
text: They are manufacturing panic.

title: S05-D07-byte-take001
text: Well, it is working. I am panicking.

title: S05-D08-trixie-take001
text: Save the timestamp. And the old price. We need something people can check.

title: S05-D09-byte-take001
text: Done. Apparently dinner now comes with an investigation.

title: S05-D10-trixie-take001
text: We are going to tell the whole district.

title: Scene 06 — complete dialogue review
text: All dialogue in script order. Dialogue-only review; action, effects and final picture timing remain separate.

title: S06-D01-trixie-take001
text: They tripled the price before they announced the shortage!

title: S06-D02-civilian_1-take001
text: Those bastards! I sold my litter box to buy dinner!

title: S06-D03-byte-take001
text: Okay, that's a personal budgeting problem.

title: S06-N01-byte-take001
text: Bad joke. Sorry. Keep your receipt; it can help us prove when the price changed.

title: S06-N02-neon-take001
text: I can put the two timestamps side by side. Big enough for the back of the market.

title: S06-N03-ghost-take001
text: Hide the customers’ names. We need prices, not a list of people for the patrols.

title: S06-N04-trixie-take001
text: If you bought fish today, compare your receipt. Do not take our word for it.

title: S06-N05-onyx-take001
text: Leave a path through the crowd. People still need to get home.

title: Scene 07 — complete dialogue review
text: All dialogue in script order. Dialogue-only review; action, effects and final picture timing remain separate.

title: S07-D01-trixie-take001
text: They think we're stupid! They think they can take our food, triple the price, and tell us to be grateful!

title: S07-D02-civilian_1-take001
text: NO MORE BONES! GIVE US SALMON!

title: S07-D03-onyx-take001
text: That's the dumbest chant I've ever heard.

title: S07-D04-neon-take001
text: It's trending.

title: S07-N01-byte-take001
text: Here is yesterday’s price. Here is this morning’s. Same shop, same pack, three times the money.

title: S07-N02-ghost-take001
text: This proves the timing. It does not tell us where the fish went. We still need the shipping records.

title: S07-N03-trixie-take001
text: Then we ask for them. Every district deserves to know who gets fed and who gets left out.

title: S07-N04-neon-take001
text: I have mirrored the receipts. If this screen goes dark, the evidence stays online.

title: S07-N05-onyx-take001
text: And nobody smashes the stalls. These people are our neighbors, not the people setting the prices.

title: S07-N06-trixie-take001
text: Keep your receipts. Help your neighbors. We are going to find an answer.

title: Scene 08 — complete dialogue review
text: All dialogue in script order. Dialogue-only review; action, effects and final picture timing remain separate.

title: S08-D01-district7_kitten-take001
text: Are you really going to bring the salmon back?

title: S08-D02-trixie-take001
text: We're going to find out where it went.

title: S08-D03-byte-take001
text: You realize we have no fucking idea where it went?

title: S08-D04-trixie-take001
text: Working on that.

title: S08-N01-district7_kitten-take001
text: Mum says promises do not fit in a bowl.

title: S08-N02-trixie-take001
text: She is right. I will not promise what I cannot deliver. But I will not forget you.

title: S08-N03-byte-take001
text: You have made that significantly harder to walk away from.

title: S08-N04-trixie-take001
text: Good. Get the others. We start with who profits from the panic.

title: Scene 09 — complete dialogue review
text: All dialogue in script order. Dialogue-only review; action, effects and final picture timing remain separate.

title: S09-D01-ghost-take001
text: Barkington has a private dinner tonight.

title: S09-D02-byte-take001
text: With the WOOF7 news anchor.

title: S09-D03-neon-take001
text: The same network telling everyone to panic-buy salmon.

title: S09-D04-trixie-take001
text: Then let's see what's on the menu.

title: S09-N01-byte-take001
text: Every price update came through the same corporate feed. The shops did not choose it individually.

title: S09-N02-ghost-take001
text: The message content is encrypted. The meeting confirmation is not. Same names, same time, one private room.

title: S09-N03-neon-take001
text: Steak and Bone. Their public booking map shows a service corridor behind the dining room.

title: S09-N04-onyx-take001
text: So we walk in and ask nicely?

title: S09-N05-trixie-take001
text: We watch. We record. We leave. Nobody starts a fight over a suspicion.

title: S09-N06-byte-take001
text: A photograph of two dogs having dinner is not going to prove much.

title: S09-N07-ghost-take001
text: Correct. Which is why we need to hear what they say.

title: S09-N08-neon-take001
text: The microphone needs line of sight. I can hide it in the service hatch.

title: Scene 10 — complete dialogue review
text: All dialogue in script order. Dialogue-only review; action, effects and final picture timing remain separate.

title: S10-D01-neon-take001
text: The guards will chase these instead of us.

title: S10-D02-byte-take001
text: What if they don't?

title: S10-D03-neon-take001
text: Then we have a very expensive collection of dog toys.

title: S10-D04-onyx-take001
text: Holy shit. It works.

title: S10-N01-trixie-take001
text: One job each. Ghost finds the route. Neon handles the decoys. Byte watches the cameras. Onyx covers the exit.

title: S10-N02-byte-take001
text: And you?

title: S10-N03-trixie-take001
text: I get close enough to photograph the meeting.

title: S10-N04-neon-take001
text: They follow the sound and the smell. This switch cuts both. Do not press the red button indoors.

title: S10-N05-onyx-take001
text: You could have said that before the demonstration.

title: S10-N06-ghost-take001
text: The return path has to stay clear. A distraction that traps us is just a different problem.

title: S10-N07-neon-take001
text: Two decoys for entry. One held back. I actually planned for something going wrong.

title: S10-N08-byte-take001
text: Write down the date. We should celebrate this.

title: Scene 11 — complete dialogue review
text: All dialogue in script order. Dialogue-only review; action, effects and final picture timing remain separate.

title: S11-D01-byte-take001
text: That restaurant costs more per meal than our entire building.

title: S11-D02-onyx-take001
text: Can we eat first?

title: S11-D03-ghost-take001
text: Target's inside.

title: S11-D04-trixie-take001
text: Nobody touches anything until we have evidence.

title: S11-N01-ghost-take001
text: Front door has two guards. Service door has one camera. Their patrol crosses the alley every forty seconds.

title: S11-N02-byte-take001
text: I am staying at this relay point. If you lose my signal, do not invent a heroic alternative.

title: S11-N03-onyx-take001
text: I stay by the service exit. Same way in, same way out.

title: S11-N04-trixie-take001
text: That is Barkington. The entourage came in the limousine. Keep the plate in the recording.

title: S11-N05-neon-take001
text: The anchor is already inside. Private room, rear wall, blinds half closed.

title: S11-N06-ghost-take001
text: We can reach the hatch without crossing the main dining room.

title: S11-N07-trixie-take001
text: Wait for the patrol to turn. We go together, and we leave together.

title: Scene 12 — complete dialogue review
text: All dialogue in script order. Dialogue-only review; action, effects and final picture timing remain separate.

title: S12-D01-dog_guard_a-take001
text: Maintain your positions!
voice_name: Jerry B. - Gruff and Gritty Commander

title: S12-D02-dog_guard_a-take001
text: ...Is that a bacon-flavored bone?
voice_name: Jerry B. - Gruff and Gritty Commander

title: S12-D03-dog_guard_b-take001
text: MINE!

title: S12-N01-neon-take001
text: First decoy on the ground. Second one stays behind the bins until they move.

title: S12-N02-byte-take001
text: Camera is looking at the alley. You have your opening.

title: S12-N03-ghost-take001
text: Door is clear. Trixie, on me.

title: S12-N04-onyx-take001
text: I have the exit. Do not make me come looking for you.

title: Scene 13 — complete dialogue review
text: All dialogue in script order. Dialogue-only review; action, effects and final picture timing remain separate.

title: S13-D01-byte-take001
text: You have forty seconds before patrol returns.

title: S13-D02-trixie-take001
text: Ghost, move.

title: S13-D03-ghost-take001
text: I am moving.

title: S13-D04-trixie-take001
text: You're literally standing still.

title: S13-D05-ghost-take001
text: That's why I'm good.

title: S13-N01-neon-take001
text: Service robot. Hold. Its camera turns before the wheels do.

title: S13-N02-byte-take001
text: Twenty seconds. Stop narrating your stealth and actually do some.

title: S13-N03-ghost-take001
text: Now. Stay behind the cart; the lens cannot see through it.

title: S13-N04-trixie-take001
text: There is the hatch. Neon, microphone first. I need the table and both faces.

title: S13-N05-neon-take001
text: Recording locally. If the connection drops, we still keep the file.

title: Scene 14 — complete dialogue review
text: All dialogue in script order. Dialogue-only review; action, effects and final picture timing remain separate.

title: S14-D01-chairman_barkington-take001
text: The public needs reassurance that our supply measures are necessary.

title: S14-D02-woof7_anchor-take001
text: And you want that to be tonight's headline?

title: S14-D03-chairman_barkington-take001
text: I want the public to hear the correct story.

title: S14-D04-woof7_anchor-take001
text: That kind of coverage isn't cheap.

title: S14-D05-chairman_barkington-take001
text: Neither is loyalty.

title: S14-N01-woof7_anchor-take001
text: People are asking why the shelves emptied before the warning. They expect me to ask that question.

title: S14-N02-chairman_barkington-take001
text: Questions are useful when they lead the public toward confidence. Less useful when they lead to disorder.

title: S14-N03-woof7_anchor-take001
text: Confidence is difficult to sell to an audience that cannot afford dinner.

title: S14-N04-chairman_barkington-take001
text: Then remind them who keeps the streets safe. Panic needs a firm voice.

title: S14-N05-woof7_anchor-take001
text: My producers will want a reason to move the other story off the schedule.

title: S14-N06-chairman_barkington-take001
text: Tell them we appreciate a reliable partner. Our appreciation is rarely symbolic.

title: Scene 15 — complete dialogue review
text: All dialogue in script order. Dialogue-only review; action, effects and final picture timing remain separate.

title: S15-D01-byte-take001
text: Please tell me you got that.

title: S15-D02-trixie-take001
text: Every pixel.

title: S15-D03-neon-take001
text: The audio's ambiguous.

title: S15-D04-trixie-take001
text: The photograph isn't.

title: S15-N01-neon-take001
text: Both faces and the bag are in frame. Keep rolling. Do not crop away who handed it over.

title: S15-N02-ghost-take001
text: Someone is coming down the corridor. You have one clean shot.

title: S15-N03-trixie-take001
text: Save the original and a copy. No filters, no edits.

title: S15-N04-byte-take001
text: It proves a payment happened. We still cannot label what the money bought.

title: S15-N05-trixie-take001
text: Then we show exactly what we have. Nothing more.

title: S15-N06-onyx-take001
text: Patrol is back early. Time to move.

title: Scene 16 — complete dialogue review
text: All dialogue in script order. Dialogue-only review; action, effects and final picture timing remain separate.

title: S16-D01-dog_guard_a-take001
text: STOP THOSE CATS!
voice_name: Jerry B. - Gruff and Gritty Commander

title: S16-D02-neon-take001
text: Emergency bone!

title: S16-D03-byte-take001
text: Why do you call it that?

title: S16-D04-neon-take001
text: Because it's for emergencies, dumbass!

title: S16-N01-onyx-take001
text: This door. Keep moving. I am right behind you.

title: S16-N02-ghost-take001
text: Left at the bins. The ladder goes to the low roof, not the street.

title: S16-N03-byte-take001
text: I have your signal again. Bring the files to me, not the guards.

title: S16-N04-trixie-take001
text: Count off. Byte? Neon? Ghost? Onyx?

title: S16-N05-onyx-take001
text: Five cats. One terrible restaurant. Never going back.

title: Scene 17 — complete dialogue review
text: All dialogue in script order. Dialogue-only review; action, effects and final picture timing remain separate.

title: S17-D01-nip7_anchor-take001
text: Exclusive tonight: leaked footage shows Chairman Barkington Orders making an undisclosed cash payment to a senior WOOF7 journalist.

title: S17-D02-byte-take001
text: We fucking got him!

title: S17-D03-ghost-take001
text: We got the payment. Not the reason.

title: S17-D04-trixie-take001
text: Then we keep digging.

title: S17-N01-ghost-take001
text: Send the uncut clip with the photograph. Let the newsroom check the timestamp themselves.

title: S17-N02-neon-take001
text: Original saved here. Backup sent. They cannot erase it by taking down one post.

title: S17-N03-trixie-take001
text: The headline says payment. It does not say we solved the shortage.

title: S17-N04-nip7_anchor-take001
text: The purpose of the payment has not been independently established. We have requested a response from both parties.

title: S17-N05-byte-take001
text: Fine. A small victory. Can small victories buy dinner?

title: Scene 18 — complete dialogue review
text: All dialogue in script order. Dialogue-only review; action, effects and final picture timing remain separate.

title: S18-D01-byte-take001
text: We exposed the bastard!

title: S18-D02-trixie-take001
text: Then why are the stores still empty?

title: S18-D03-ghost-take001
text: Because we exposed a payment. Not the supply chain.

title: S18-D04-neon-take001
text: Wait. I've got something.

title: S18-N01-civilian_2-take001
text: I read your story. The freezer is still empty. What do we eat tonight?

title: S18-N02-trixie-take001
text: You are right. A headline is not a meal.

title: S18-N03-neon-take001
text: The delivery code matches Byte’s price record.

title: S18-N04-ghost-take001
text: Back to the lair. Follow the deliveries, not the speeches.

title: Scene 19 — complete dialogue review
text: All dialogue in script order. Dialogue-only review; action, effects and final picture timing remain separate.

title: S19-D01-neon-take001
text: There isn't a salmon shortage.

title: S19-D02-byte-take001
text: What?

title: S19-D03-neon-take001
text: There's a salmon shortage for cats.

title: S19-D04-onyx-take001
text: Those sons of bitches.

title: S19-N01-ghost-take001
text: These are current dispatch records. Match the truck numbers to the public gate camera before we publish.

title: S19-N02-byte-take001
text: District Seven order cancelled. District Two replacement accepted. Same load, same morning.

title: S19-N03-trixie-take001
text: Save the records. We verify the trucks at the gate, then get that food moving.

title: Scene 20 — complete dialogue review
text: All dialogue in script order. Dialogue-only review; action, effects and final picture timing remain separate.

title: S20-D01-trixie-take001
text: They've been sitting on our food.

title: S20-D02-byte-take001
text: Technically, they've been shipping it.

title: S20-D03-trixie-take001
text: Not helping, Byte.

title: S20-N01-ghost-take001
text: The plate matches. That is the truck from the dispatch record.

title: S20-N02-neon-take001
text: Standing robot dogs on the floor. Red visors. They patrol the line and respond to the alarm.

title: S20-N03-trixie-take001
text: No one touches the cooling system. We need the fish fresh, and the workers clear.

title: Scene 21 — complete dialogue review
text: All dialogue in script order. Dialogue-only review; action, effects and final picture timing remain separate.

title: S21-D01-byte-take001
text: That's enough salmon to feed half the city!

title: S21-D02-trixie-take001
text: And they told us there was none.

title: S21-D03-onyx-take001
text: Can I punch something now?

title: S21-D04-trixie-take001
text: You have my permission.

title: S21-N01-ghost-take001
text: Service lock is open. Stay behind the tank until the robot turns.

title: S21-N02-neon-take001
text: Dispatch terminal here. Refrigeration is on a separate circuit.

title: S21-N03-onyx-take001
text: A robot. I am punching a robot. We are being specific.

title: S21-N04-trixie-take001
text: Keep it away from the tanks. Byte, get the truck routes.

title: Scene 22 — complete dialogue review
text: All dialogue in script order. Dialogue-only review; action, effects and final picture timing remain separate.

title: S22-D01-neon-take001
text: Corporate routing disabled.

title: S22-D02-ghost-take001
text: Shipping records released.

title: S22-D03-byte-take001
text: Salmon is going back to the cats!

title: S22-D04-trixie-take001
text: Now that's what I call a hostile takeover.

title: S22-N01-neon-take001
text: Dispatch stopped. Cooling stays on. Temperature is stable.

title: S22-N02-ghost-take001
text: Original logs preserved. Public copies include the truck numbers and cancelled orders.

title: S22-N03-trixie-take001
text: Release the already-loaded trucks first. Do not leave fresh stock waiting outside.

title: S22-N04-byte-take001
text: District Seven delivery accepted. The other neglected districts are next in the queue.

title: Scene 23 — complete dialogue review
text: All dialogue in script order. Dialogue-only review; action, effects and final picture timing remain separate.

title: S23-D01-nip7_anchor-take001
text: Newly released records confirm that Goodboy Global diverted salmon shipments away from feline neighborhoods.

title: S23-D02-byte-take001
text: We saved the fucking city!

title: S23-D03-trixie-take001
text: We saved dinner.

title: S23-D04-ghost-take001
text: For now.

title: S23-N01-district7_kitten-take001
text: You found it!

title: S23-N02-trixie-take001
text: Your mum was right. This is better than a promise.

title: Scene 24 — complete dialogue review
text: All dialogue in script order. Dialogue-only review; action, effects and final picture timing remain separate.

title: S24-D01-trixie-take001
text: All right. Now it's time to finish this mission.

title: S24-D02-byte-take001
text: We've been trying to finish this shit all day.

title: S24-D03-neon-take001
text: At least nobody can interrupt us now.

title: S24-D04-woof7_anchor-take001
text: Goodboy Global HAS AN IMPORTANT ANNOUNCEMENT—

title: S24-D05-onyx-take001
text: OH, FUCK OFF!

title: FX01-hideout-room
text: For scenes 1, 2, 9, 10, 17, 19, 24. Quiet abandoned warehouse living room at night, soft old computer cooling fans, distant rain against high windows, low electrical CRT hum. Intimate room tone, no music, no voices.

title: FX02-controller-foley
text: For scenes 1, 2, 24. Close dry plastic game controller button clicks and thumbstick movements in short irregular bursts, two controllers, no voices, no music, no background.

title: FX03-tv-game-action
text: For scenes 1, 24. Fictional arcade car chase heard from a small old television speaker: engine revving, tire skid, short cartoon bank-heist gunfire bursts, distant police siren, a crash and debris. No speech, no music. Narrow small speaker sound.

title: FX04-broadcast-interruption
text: For scenes 2, 3, 17. Old CRT television crackle, brief digital interruption glitch followed by a clean corporate news alert chime, then low electronic hum. No speech or music.

title: FX05-district-street
text: For scenes 4, 6, 8, 18, 23. Rainy neon city backstreet ambience, distant traffic passing, wet pavement tire hiss, faint market awnings creaking, urban ventilation. No intelligible or unintelligible voices, no music.

title: FX06-shop-freezer
text: For scenes 5. Small convenience store freezer aisle room tone, refrigerator compressors and fluorescent light hum, gentle cold ventilation, very quiet. No voices, no music.

title: FX07-crowd-movement
text: For scenes 6, 7, 8, 23. Large outdoor rally crowd physical movement only: many soft footsteps, clothing rustle, occasional handclaps, flags flapping. No speech, no chanting, no vocal sounds, no music.

title: FX08-hacking-interface
text: For scenes 9, 17, 19, 22. Cyberpunk computer keyboard typing in several short bursts, restrained electronic confirmation beeps, final successful data upload chime. No speech, no music.

title: FX09-bone-decoy
text: For scenes 10, 12, 16. Small plastic mechanical dog chew bone squeaks twice, tiny servo whirr, rolls across concrete, bounces three times and squeaks again. Comic practical prop sound, no animal voices, no music.

title: FX10-luxury-restaurant

title: FX11-stealth-footsteps
text: For scenes 13, 15, 16. Soft stealth boots moving on polished stone corridor, pause, gentle cloth movement, one quiet camera shutter click. Close dry foley, no voices, no music.

title: FX12-security-alarm
text: For scenes 16, 21. Industrial security alarm, measured alternating electronic warning tones in a concrete corridor, distant heavy boot footsteps. No speech, no music.

title: FX13-salmon-factory
text: For scenes 20, 21, 22. Large refrigerated fish processing plant, steady conveyor belt motors, aquarium water pumps, robotic arm pneumatic servos moving periodically, deep refrigeration compressor. No voices or music.

title: FX14-robot-dog-steps
text: For scenes 20, 21. Heavy bipedal robotic guard walking on metal factory floor, six measured armored footsteps with joint servos and hydraulic hiss. Two legs, no animal growls, no speech, no music.

title: FX15-truck-delivery
text: For scenes 20, 22, 23. Electric refrigerated delivery truck approaches slowly, brakes hiss, motor stops, cargo door slides open, wooden crate lands gently on pavement. No voices, no music.

title: FX16-newspaper
text: For scenes 17, 18. Newspaper printing rollers run briefly, followed by crisp newspaper unfolding and page turning close to microphone. No speech, no music.
